Aufgaben
Führung & Coaching

Du kennst die Stärken und Entwicklungsfelder deiner KAMs und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter.
Du definierst gemeinsam mit deinen Teammitgliedern konkrete Entwicklungsziele und Maßnahmen.
Du coachst direkt an realen Accounts, Opportunities und Kundensituationen.
Du entwickelst deine KAMs insbesondere in den Bereichen Neukundenakquisition, strategisches Account Management, Value Selling, Entscheider-Management, Verhandlung und Closing.
Du bereitest wichtige Kundentermine und Verhandlungen gemeinsam mit deinen KAMs vor und reflektierst diese anschließend.
Du gibst Verantwortung nicht an dich, sondern an dein Team zurück und entwickelst dadurch Selbstständigkeit und Ownership.

Vertriebssteuerung & Performance

Du übersetzt unsere Unternehmens- und Sales-Ziele in klare Ziele und Erwartungen für das Team.
Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit den KAMs Umsatz, Pipeline, Account-Entwicklung und Neukundenakquisition.
Du stellst eine belastbare Pipeline und einen realistischen Forecast sicher.
Du erkennst frühzeitig Risiken, Pipeline-Lücken und Performance-Abweichungen und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team konkrete Maßnahmen ein.

Sales Excellence

Du entwickelst das Team von reaktiver Kundenbetreuung hin zu aktiver und strategischer Geschäftsentwicklung.
Du stärkst die Ownership für Pipeline, Umsatz und nachhaltiges Subskriptionswachstum.

Du bringst insbesondere Erfahrung mit in:

erfolgreicher Neukundenakquisition
strategischer Account-Entwicklung
komplexen Sales-Prozessen
Value Selling

unternehmerischem und kaufmännischem Denken

Vormachen → gemeinsam machen → Verantwortung übergeben.

title: Founding AI Engineer @handly - 20VC backed
description_clean:
Germany has about a million trade businesses. They do more than €700 billion of work a year, and they run almost all of it by hand: quotes in the evening, invoices on the weekend, payments chased between jobs.
For decades, the software built for them was made for desk workers. Forms, menus, dropdowns, buttons. None of it was made for people who are always on the go and only care about the outcome.
AI changes that. For the first time, the admin of a trade business can be done for the owner instead of by them.
We are building a business-in-a-box for the trades.
Tradespeople want outcomes done for them, with as little interaction with software as possible. handly takes care of leads, quotes, measurements, invoicing and payments, so they can focus on their craft, and is accountable for the result.
We started with roofers in Germany. Other trades are next.
Delivering outcomes is a much harder problem than delivering software. That is the job of an AI-native services company. Most of our vision has not been built yet, and we are looking for top-tier talent in Berlin to help us bring it to life.
We are a small, close-knit team in Berlin-Mitte, backed by 20VC, Stride and Base10. We build, experiment and move fast, and we have found creative ways to use AI in every part of the company: product, ops, go-to-market and admin.
about the role
This role is for engineers who want to push what AI can do for a real business. As our founding AI engineer, you'll have high agency to hone your skills with AI and solve hard real-world problems that bring delightful experiences to our partners.
The biggest opportunity at handly: we run the entire administration of our partners, rather than one vertical of their needs. That gives AI the room to take on large, autonomous tasks end to end, and gives us room to get very creative with what AI can do as we capture more and more channels of communication.
You will own AI products end to end, make the core product and technical decisions, and turn messy, real-world workflows into AI that does the work for our partners.
We are a small team working on:

modernizing the user experience of an underserved industry
reimagining workflows that have not changed in decades, with AI
moving from AI workflows to high-autonomy agents
capturing data and context from calls, emails, photos, documents and voice

Tasks
AI already runs in production across handly: intelligence on every customer call, automatic payment matching, a daily briefing for every partner. Some of the bigger projects you will contribute to or lead:

Quote generation. Turn voice notes, photos and documents from customers and architects into a six-figure quote, priced intelligently from the partner's own catalog.
Measurements. Measure buildings from satellite imagery, drone footage and public building data, without a site visit.
Back office in natural language. An MCP layer over the whole product, so partners can manage their back office in a chat.
Email intelligence. Capture intelligence from email threads and attachments, automate communication with clients and suppliers, and aggressive anti-phishing and spam protection.
Self-improving pipelines. Use every correction, edit and rejection to improve the next output.
Evals. Build the evaluation sets and benchmarks that gate every AI feature before it ships.

Requirements

Have 4+ years of full-stack engineering experience (exceptions apply for exceptional engineers)
You have shipped AI features that real users depend on, and continiously evloved them.
Strong full-stack TypeScript comfortable across backend, web and mobile.
Experience building evals, benchmarks and self-improving loops that automate research on AI capabilities.
Creative about capturing data and context (transcripts, photos, documents, voice) to improve AI features.
Strong prompt engineering: structured outputs, tool use, agents, and good judgment about when an LLM is the wrong tool.
Comfortable with ambiguity. You lead your projects end to end and want to grow with the company.
Bonus: you have built your own fully functional AI side project. Send us your best one.

our tech stack

Full-stack TypeScript: Node.js, Express, Drizzle, Postgres
Web: React, Vite, React Query, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Zod
Mobile: React Native, Expo, EAS, React Query
AI: Vercel AI SDK, promptfoo, OpenAI and Anthropic models
Building: we use AI extensively to build, with zero friction adopting the best tools, and we built a custom software factory that takes care of small tasks
Infra: AWS, PostHog, Sentry

what may not make you a good fit

you prefer a remote or hybrid setup
you want to be told exactly what to do
you mostly care about the tech, not the outcome for the customer
you want to work 9-5

Benefits

competitive compensation package, €80–110k + 0.4–0.7% equity
unlimited access to frontier models and our always-on software factory
as much responsibility as you want, flat hierarchy
fast loops and direct feedback from the people who use what you build
minimal meetings: we have plannings and demo Fridays, No stand-ups, we like to maximize our focus time.
a tight, ambitious team that enjoys building hard things together from the comfort of our office.
regular team outings: dinners, padel, events and movie nights
a modern, light-filled office in Berlin-Mitte and great vibes ^^

Process

Intro with Ohan (30m)
Technical Background with Kais (45m)
AI Product Engineering Challenge (3-4h)
On-site with the product team and our CEO Basti - white-boarding, product taste & culture (half-day)

That’s it! We’ll reach out with an offer.
Start date: ASAP
Location: Berlin only, in-office

B. durch Famulaturen), der/die Lust hat, die Digitalisierung von Arztpraxen aktiv mitzugestalten. Du bringst dein Praxiswissen direkt in unsere Produktentwicklung ein – über unser gesamtes, wachsendes Produktportfolio hinweg – und trägst gleichzeitig dazu bei, dass Praxen einfacher, moderner und effizienter arbeiten können.
Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produktteam zusammen, remote mit flexiblem Standort – idealerweise mit Sitz in Karlsruhe für gelegentliche Abstimmungen vor Ort.
Aufgaben

Du bringst Insights aus dem echten Praxisalltag (Abläufe, Pain Points, Bedürfnisse von Ärzt*innen und Praxispersonal) in unsere Produktentwicklung ein – nicht nur für MediVoice, sondern für unser gesamtes Produktportfolio.
Du hilfst dabei, neue Features und Produkte aus medizinischer Perspektive zu bewerten und mitzugestalten.
Du unterstützt bei der Erhebung und Auswertung von Nutzerfeedback aus Praxen (Interviews, Gespräche, strukturierte Auswertungen).

Qualifikation

Medizinstudium, mindestens nach dem 1. Staatsexamen.
Erste praktische Erfahrung in der Patientenversorgung (Famulatur, PJ, Nebenjob in einer Praxis/Klinik o. Ä.).
Echtes Interesse an Digitalisierung im Gesundheitswesen und Lust, Prozesse aus der Praxis heraus zu verbessern.
Strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise – besonders im Remote-Setting.
Hohe Affinität zu KI und Bereitschaft, KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen.
Verfügbarkeit von 15–20 Stunden pro Woche (flexibel einteilbar, in Semesterferien gerne mehr).
Optional: Interesse, Praktika oder Abschlussarbeiten mit Praxisbezug bei uns einzubringen – wir unterstützen dich dabei.

Sprachkenntnisse

Deutsch: Muttersprache oder mindestens Niveau B2
Englisch: Fließend

Benefits

Remote-first mit flexiblem Standort – idealerweise Karlsruhe für gelegentliche Abstimmungen vor Ort.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten, kompatibel mit Klinik- und Studienalltag.
Urban Sports Club Abo – für Sport und Ausgleich, flexibel nutzbar.
Hoher Impact – deine Praxiserfahrung fließt direkt in Produktentscheidungen ein, die tausenden Arztpraxen zugutekommen.
Direkter Zugang zu Produktentwicklung, Tech und Gründerteam – und Einblick in den Aufbau eines wachsenden Produktportfolios.
Möglichkeit zur fachlichen Betreuung von Praktika, Bachelor- oder Masterarbeiten mit Praxisbezug.
Ein junges, motiviertes Team, das sinnvolle Health-Tech-Produkte entwickelt.

Warum diese Rolle?
Kaum jemand kennt den Praxisalltag so gut wie jemand, der ihn selbst erlebt hat. Genau dieses Wissen fehlt vielen Produktteams in der Digital-Health-Branche – bei uns bringst du es direkt ein, und zwar nicht nur für ein Produkt, sondern für ein ganzes, wachsendes Portfolio. Du übersetzt medizinische Realität in Produktentscheidungen und siehst, wie deine Impulse tatsächlich im Produkt landen.
Bewerbung & Nächste Schritte
Wie geht es weiter? Wir melden uns zeitnah bei dir. Wenn uns deine Unterlagen überzeugen, laden wir dich zu einem kurzen Video-Call mit uns ein, um uns kennenzulernen und offene Fragen zu klären.
Deine Bewerbung: Bitte sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Anschreiben. Erzähl uns, welche praktische Erfahrung du bislang in Praxen oder Kliniken gesammelt hast und was dir dabei besonders aufgefallen ist – positiv wie negativ.
Bonus-Challenge (optional): Beschreibe uns eine konkrete Situation aus deiner bisherigen Praxiserfahrung, in der ein digitales Tool (oder das Fehlen eines solchen) den Ablauf spürbar erleichtert oder erschwert hat.

title: UVC Partners: Data & AI - Master Thesis / Internship (f/m/x)
description_clean: About usUVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies.Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha.At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way.Your missionYou will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions.Your profileYou are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university.You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro).You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals.You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop.You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it.You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required.How we workWe are an AI-powered development team. Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write.Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you.Potential Research DirectionsThese are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads.1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot.2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data.3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several.Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own.What we offerNetwork: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors.Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events.Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship.Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions.Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on.AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly.Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively.Interested?Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you!Diversity is important to usDiversity enriches our team. In this role, you'll combine deep technical skill with strong product thinking to build tools and features using AI that create real value for our users and our business. You'll own features end to end - from scoping and design through development, deployment, and adoption - and use AI to build smarter and faster at every step.This is a role for builders who care about impact: people who understand both the user perspective and the underlying business processes, who can scope what needs to be built and then make it happen.Your MissionEnd-to-End Product Delivery: Own features from concept to production and real users, not just code -ship complete solutions that drive measurable business value. Translate product ideas and stakeholder input into shipped experiences that users actually adopt.Building AI into Products: Design and integrate AI-powered features into our platform - not just using coding assistants, but building AI solutions that solve real problems for our users. Turn repeated work into shared building blocks (UI components, data import flows, AI pipelines) so each new tool is faster to build than the last.Stakeholder Collaboration & Adoption: Work with stakeholders at all levels - from leadership to operations - to align on priorities and drive adoption of new tools and features. Communicate technical concepts clearly and build buy-in for your solutions across the organisation.Continuous Improvement: Gather feedback early, iterate quickly, and continuously improve what you build. Backend experience with Node.js, Express or comparable, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL with practical SQL. title: Working Student IT Strategy & Governance (all genders)
description_clean: Über tonies:tonies ist die weltweit führende interaktive Audio-Plattform für Kinder mit mehr als 10 Millionen verkauften Tonieboxen und 125 Millionen verkauften Tonies. Das intuitive und preisgekrönte Audiosystem hat mit seinem kindersicheren, kabellosen und bildschirmfreien Ansatz die Art und Weise verändert, wie kleine Kinder selbstständig spielen und lernen. Tonieboxen wurden bereits in über 100 Ländern aktiviert und das Inhaltsportfolio umfasst rund 1.400 Tonies in mehreren Sprachen. Seit der Gründung hat tonies bedeutende Meilensteine erreicht – darunter den Börsengang an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im November 2021 sowie ein weltweit präsentes Team von über 550 engagierten Experten, die aus verschiedenen Ländern agieren.Teil unseres tonies-Teams zu werden bedeutet, Teil einer inspirierenden Mission zu sein: innovative und bedeutungsvolle Erlebnisse für Kinder auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie.Du als Teil von tonies:Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten zur Verstärkung unseres IT Strategy & Governance Teams, der unsere Experten innerhalb der CIO- & CPO-Einheiten dabei unterstützt, das nachhaltige Wachstum von tonies voranzutreiben.Du wirst eng mit dem Enterprise Architect, dem IT Governance Analysten und dem Manager Trust & Security zusammenarbeiten, um die IT-Strategie, Standards und Leitplanken zu definieren. So ermöglichst du es den tonies-Mitarbeitenden, unserer wachsenden globalen Kundenbasis effektiv sichere und stabile Produkte mit einem skalierbaren Fundament zu bieten.Diese Rolle ist ideal für jemanden, der organisiert, zuverlässig und lernbegierig ist sowie Interesse daran hat, eine Karriere im IT-Bereich in einem internationalen Umfeld aufzubauen.Deine Aufgaben umfassen:IT-Strategie & ArchitekturBewerten der tonies-Systemlandschaft im Hinblick auf den strategischen Fit.Unterstützen strategischer IT-Projekte (z. B. Stammdatenmanagement, Lizenzgebühren/Royalties, E-Commerce).Pflegen der Enterprise-Architektur-Dokumentation in LeanIX.IT-Governance & SicherheitVorqualifizieren neuer Software-Anfragen und Beraten fachübergreifender Stakeholder (IT, Data/AI, Einkauf, Legal).Pflegen des tonies-Applikationsportfolios (System Ownership, CIA-Scoring, Kosten, Nutzung etc.).Optimieren von Verlängerungsprozessen durch Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Aktualisierung des Softwarelizenz-Verlängerungsplans.Aufsetzen und iteratives Weiterentwickeln von IT-Security-Onlinetrainingsmodulen für Mitarbeitende.Unterstützen von ISO 27001-, ITIL- und allgemeinen Compliance-Initiativen.Was wir uns von dir wünschen:Studienstatus: Derzeit eingeschrieben in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang (z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Informationsmanagement oder einem verwandten Bereich).Bereichsinteresse: Starkes Interesse an IT-Architektur, Enterprise Security und Governance-Standards.Denkweise: Bewusster Umgang mit modernen Tools – nach dem Motto „Think First, AI Second“.Tech Stack: Vertrautheit mit den gängigen Produktivitäts-Suites (Google Workspace oder Microsoft 365).Arbeitsweise: Strukturiert, zuverlässig und detailorientiert mit der Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für übertragene Aufgaben zu übernehmen.Soft Skills: Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, sowohl eigenständig als auch im Team zu arbeiten.Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich (Englisch ist ein Plus).Warum tonies?Zu unseren Grundsätzen gehört es, dass wir uns bei tonies® für Inklusion und Vielfalt einsetzen. title: Founding Engineer - atmo (Berlin-based / Hybrid)
description_clean:
At atmo, we've built a core AI product at the intersection of agricultural transition and green finance. As an early-stage company moving from first rollout to scale, we're looking for a hands-on Founding Engineer to join our founding team and help build the AI backbone of our product.
Over the past year, we've deliberately evolved from a pure data product into an AI-first platform. AI is now central to everything we do - from ingesting messy, real-world agricultural data to unlocking new financing flows for sustainable farming. We're looking for someone who wants to get hands-on: building and managing the AI agents that power the product, and working closely with our CSO to turn science models into shipped features.
About atmo
atmo is building the infrastructure for financing the transition of agriculture.
Agriculture is facing massive pressure to adapt - from climate change and rising input costs to new technologies and changing market requirements. Yet farmers and their financing partners often lack the data, tools and business cases needed to make the right investment decisions.
atmo is an AI-powered Agriculture Finance OS that brings farm, climate and financial data together to turn complex agricultural transition investments into clear, bankable business cases. Our platform helps farmers identify profitable transition opportunities, assess ROI and financing needs, access relevant solution providers and generate bank-ready financing reports. For banks and other financial institutions, atmo provides the data and decision intelligence needed to confidently finance the next generation of agricultural investments.
We work across the agricultural ecosystem, including farmers, banks, solution providers and food companies, and are already active in Germany, the Netherlands and the UK, with partnerships and pilots across leading financial and agricultural organisations.
Founded in Berlin in 2023, atmo is backed by leading investors, accelerators and non-dilutive funding programmes. We are a lean, ambitious team combining deep expertise in agriculture, finance, climate science, AI and B2B SaaS - with the goal of making agricultural transition investable at scale.
Tasks
What you'll do

Build, run and continuously improve the LLM pipelines at the heart of atmo's product - classifying farm records, soil samples and financial statements, extracting structured data from them, and generating bank-ready reports - from prompting and orchestration to evaluation and monitoring
Own the platform end-to-end: a Python/FastAPI backend, Next.js web apps and the AWS infrastructure they run on
Partner closely with our CSO on the scientific engine, defining the interface between science and product and turning new models into production-ready features
Make AI outputs trustworthy: evaluations, guardrails and clear provenance, so every number in a financing case can be traced back to its source
Ship fast and iterate constantly, using modern AI tooling to move with a small, high-leverage team

Requirements
What we're looking for

Hands-on builder - you'd rather be in the codebase than in a meeting
Strong Python backend depth (FastAPI or similar, SQL, background jobs), comfortable across the stack in TypeScript/Next.js and owning infrastructure on AWS
Practical experience running LLM-based systems in production, not just prototypes: structured extraction, evaluation, cost and latency, handling failures gracefully
Comfortable working directly with scientific/domain experts, like our CSO, to turn models into shipped features
Fast-paced, get-it-done mindset - thrives in ambiguity and on a lean team, and takes ownership of technical decisions, not just tickets
Mission-aligned: genuine interest in climate, sustainable agriculture, and green finance
Bonus: exposure to fintech, agritech, or applied climate/agricultural science; German helps, as much of our farm data is German

Benefits
Why atmo
Building at atmo means shaping both the technology and the science behind it, side by side with the founding team. This role gives you the chance to:

Own the AI and data layer of a real climate-impact product, with real farmers and banks on the other end
Work side by side with the founding team and our CSO, shaping both product and science
A startup-stage compensation package with meaningful equity and substantial ownership from day oneSmall team (5 FTE), real impact, no layers

📍 Location: Hybrid, with a preference for London / Berlin
🌱 Womxn are encouraged to apply
If you're excited to build the AI and systems behind real climate and finance impact - we'd love to hear from you.

title: Growth Marketing Manager - Performance Marketing (m/f/d)
description_clean:
About Placetel
We are all connected by one goal: making communication simple. Placetel stands for modern, innovative, AI-native communication and CX solutions from the cloud. More than 40,000 business customers use Placetel every day to call and collaborate successfully – whether in the office, at home or on the go. Since our founding in 2008 we have grown continuously and are today part of Gamma Communications. Together we are changing the way people work around the world. Today and in the future.
Tasks
Your role
As Growth Marketing Manager – Performance Marketing you own paid acquisition at Placetel. You bring in the trials and the paying customers that our self-service growth model runs on – with real budget responsibility, across Google, Meta and every channel we have not tested yet.
One thing up front, because it shapes how we work: winning SMB customers in Germany looks far more like winning customers for a DTC brand than like classic enterprise B2B. High volume, short consideration cycles, creative-led, measured daily. That is how we run growth – and that is the mindset we are hiring for.
What you will do

Own our paid acquisition budget end to end – strategy, channel mix, allocation and daily optimisation – and be accountable for the outcome.
Plan, launch and scale campaigns across Google Ads (Search, PMax, YouTube) and Meta, plus additional channels such as LinkedIn, TikTok, Reddit, native, affiliate and comparison portals.
Manage to unit economics, not vanity metrics: trials, trial-to-paid, CAC, payback period and LTV/CAC are your scoreboard.
Build a systematic testing cadence – audiences, bidding, offers, landing pages, creative angles – with clear hypotheses, decision rules and documented learnings.
Work hand in hand with our Creative Strategist: you brief which angles to test, you read the results, you decide what scales and what dies.
Own tracking, attribution and measurement together with our analytics and eCommerce colleagues – GA4, GTM, server-side tracking, conversion values, offline conversion uploads from the CRM.
Optimise the full path from ad to trial to paid customer: landing pages, signup flow, offers and pricing tests – together with Growth, Product and Sales.
Open up channels we do not run yet and decide quickly whether they earn a permanent budget line.
Report performance transparently and in plain language: what worked, what did not, what we do next.

Requirements
Who we are looking for

Several years of hands-on performance marketing with genuine budget responsibility – ideally in B2B SaaS and/or in a DTC or high-velocity consumer brand. Both together is the strongest profile we can imagine for this role.
Pro in one channel, solid in the rest. You are the person others ask about Google Ads or Meta, and you can competently run the other channels yourself.
You think in unit economics: CAC, payback, LTV/CAC and contribution margin are part of your everyday vocabulary.
Confident with tracking, attribution and analytics setups – you fix broken measurement instead of waiting for someone else to.
A real creative instinct: you can judge an ad, brief a better one and spot a winning angle before the data fully confirms it.
Structured tester: hypothesis, sample size, decision rule, learning written down and shared.
Hands-on mentality and high ownership – you make budget calls without needing a committee.
Fluent German and English. Our customers are German SMBs; you need to feel the language they are being sold in.
A degree in marketing, business, business informatics or a comparable field – or an equivalent track record that speaks for itself.

Optional and nice to have

Experience with free-trial or freemium subscription models and self-service checkout.
Experience with comparison portals, affiliate and marketplace channels in Germany.
Experience running paid in more than one market or language.

Benefits
What we offer

Full ownership of a meaningful acquisition budget and direct, visible impact on growth and revenue.
A young, ambitious team of marketing, product and tech experts with a real growth mentality.
A company that is deliberately building a digital, self-service growth model – you will not be fighting the organisation to run modern growth.
Hybrid working model with flexible hours and a genuine remote culture – we care about output, not attendance.
Extensive learning and development opportunities across growth, SaaS and AI.
Central office location in Cologne’s Südstadt, modern workspaces and high-quality equipment. Water, coffee and fresh fruit included.
Open, collegial company culture with regular team events.

title: Creative Strategist - Paid Social (m/f/d)
description_clean:
About Placetel
We are all connected by one goal: making communication simple. Placetel stands for modern, innovative, AI-native communication and CX solutions from the cloud. More than 40,000 business customers use Placetel every day to call and collaborate successfully – whether in the office, at home or on the go. Since our founding in 2008 we have grown continuously and are today part of Gamma Communications. Together we are changing the way people work around the world. Today and in the future.
Tasks
Your role
As Creative Strategist you own the single biggest lever in our paid social performance: the creative. Meta is your home channel. You decide what we test, you make sure enough of it exists, and you read the results well enough to know why the winner won.
We are B2B, but we intend to build like a consumer brand. German SMB owners scroll the same feed as everyone else, and they do not stop for a product screenshot with a feature list. Your job is to make them stop – and then to make them start a trial.
What you will do

Own the creative engine for paid social – primarily Meta, with TikTok and YouTube as we expand.
Turn insight into angles: mine customer reviews, support tickets, sales calls, churn reasons, competitor ads and customer conversations for what German SMBs actually say about their phone system, their calls and their missed business.
Build and run a creative testing roadmap: a steady, predictable volume of new concepts every week, structured by angle, format and hook so results are readable rather than anecdotal.
Write scripts, hooks and storyboards for short-form video – UGC, founder- and employee-led, testimonial, problem/solution, product demo, static and everything in between.
Brief and direct creators, editors, actors and freelancers, run shoots, and manage the production pipeline end to end so throughput never becomes the bottleneck.
Analyse creative performance at the right level with the Performance Marketing Manager – hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA and trial rate per angle – and decide what to iterate, scale or kill.
Maintain a living library of winners, losers and learnings so we compound instead of restarting every quarter.
Systematically tear down what works elsewhere – in DTC, in consumer, at other AI and SaaS brands – and transfer the pattern to us.
Keep everything on brand and legally clean while still being genuinely entertaining.

Requirements
Who we are looking for

A track record of paid social creative that actually performed at scale, above all on Meta. Bring examples – and the numbers behind them.
You think in hooks and in the first three seconds. You can explain why an ad works, not just that it does.
You write and judge German copy at native level; solid English on top.
Production-capable, not only conceptual: when speed matters you can shoot and cut a usable ad yourself.
Comfortable with volume – dozens of variations a month, not three perfect films a quarter.
Data-literate: you can navigate Ads Manager reporting and draw your own conclusions without waiting for a dashboard.
Strong opinions about creative, loosely held – you let the results decide and you kill your darlings quickly.
Agency or in-house experience at a DTC, consumer or high-velocity SaaS brand is a strong plus.

Optional - nice to have

Experience building and managing a creator or UGC network.
Experience with AI-supported creative production (generative video, voice, image, automated variation).
Experience with landing page and post-click creative, not just the ad itself.

Benefits
What we offer

Real creative ownership: you set the testing agenda, not an agency.
A budget that makes creative testing meaningful and a performance team that will actually read your results.
The freedom to build a B2B brand that behaves like a consumer brand – with an AI-native product that gives you something genuinely new to talk about.
A young, ambitious team of marketing, product and tech experts with a real growth mentality.
Hybrid working model with flexible hours and a genuine remote culture – we care about output, not attendance.
Extensive learning and development opportunities across growth, SaaS and AI.
Central office location in Cologne’s Südstadt, modern workspaces and high-quality equipment. Water, coffee and fresh fruit included.
Open, collegial company culture with regular team events.

As Growth Marketing Manager – Automation you own the automated systems that carry a user from first signup through activation to expansion – and the CRM and AI infrastructure underneath them. Our growth model is self-service and low-touch by design. That only works if the machine behind it is genuinely good.
HubSpot sits at the centre of that machine, connected to product usage data, billing and our web and trial funnel. Your job is to make it do more, do it automatically, and do it with AI agents built natively into the flow – not bolted on as an afterthought.
We are deliberately open on the shape of this role. There are two ways to be excellent at it, and we will build the role around whichever one you bring.
What you will do – the core

Own our marketing and sales automation stack, with HubSpot (Marketing + Sales Hub) at the centre and clean connections to product, billing, website and trial funnel.
Design, build and continuously improve automated journeys across the whole lifecycle: trial onboarding, activation nudges, lead scoring and routing, upsell and cross-sell, win-back and churn prevention.
Replace manual processes with automation – every recurring task a human does today is a candidate, in marketing and in sales.
Build AI agents into the funnel natively: qualification, enrichment, routing, response drafting, content generation. Not just AI features inside HubSpot.
Keep our data trustworthy: lifecycle stages, attribution and product-usage signals flowing reliably between systems.
Measure what you build – every journey has a metric, a baseline and an iteration plan.
Work closely with Sales, Product, Growth Analytics and eCommerce, and make their work easier by removing manual steps from it.

Two possible focus areas – pick yours

Focus A – Technical / AI Automation

You architect HubSpot rather than just operate it: data model, custom objects and properties, APIs, webhooks, integrations.

Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience: workflows, custom properties and objects, lists, lifecycle stages, reporting. You know where its limits are and how to work around them.

Experience with data warehouses, reverse ETL or event pipelines.
Experience migrating or rebuilding a CRM setup rather than only maintaining one.

Die audibene Teleaudiologie ist der am schnellsten wachsende Geschäftsbereich bei audibene. Wir betreuen unsere Kunden von der ersten Beratung bis zur finalen Anpassung vollständig digital im Wohnzimmer der Kunden und bauen dieses Modell gerade in hohem Tempo weiter aus.

Analysen: Du führst eigenständig quantitative Analysen zu zentralen Kennzahlen durch – etwa zu Rabatten und Pricing, Abbruchraten im Verkaufsprozess, dem durchschnittlichen Warenkorbwert (ABV) oder der Sales-Performance nach Tageszeit und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für das Management ab.

Customer First: Jede Entscheidung startet bei der Frage, was sie für unsere Kund:innen besser macht, nicht bei der internen Bequemlichkeit.

Das ist Dein Spielfeld.

Was Du bei uns aufbauen kannst
Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Founder unsere komplette Marketingarchitektur. Du entscheidest mit:
• Welche Kanäle funktionieren?
• Welche Zielgruppen reagieren?
• Welche Inhalte erzeugen Nachfrage?
• Was können wir automatisieren?
• Welche Agenten brauchen wir?
• Wo entsteht Pipeline?
• Und was davon sollten wir sofort wieder einstellen?

Die ersten 90 Tage

Qualifikation
Wen wir suchen

Vielleicht bist Du Growth Marketer.

title: Head of Security (f/m/d)
description_clean:
1KOMMA5°
At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?
We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.
Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.
Become a part of our mission and learn  about our Product & Tech team!
Deine Position
As Head of Security, you are the security owner for Heartbeat AI GmbH, the company that builds software for the 1KOMMA5° group. You lead Team Trust, our security team inside the Core Platforms domain, and you are the person the technology organisation and the wider group turn to on security questions.
What makes this different from most security leadership roles: we don't only protect data centres and laptops. We run connected energy systems in people's homes, and those systems are part of critical energy infrastructure. You protect exactly the infrastructure that drives the transition towards renewable energy.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You build the team and the framework, and you stay close enough to the technology to make good calls yourself.
Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Leading Team Trust: direction, hiring, growth, health and mentoring.
Cloud and IoT Security: protect our cloud, our applications, and the connected hardware in our customers' homes.
Risk and Compliance: own cybersecurity frameworks and the regulations that applies to energy companies.
Identity and Access Management: internal permissions and secure development that scale with the engineering org.
Security as a Product: capabilities developers use by default.
Translating Risk: make security risk concrete for non-technical decision makers, up to C-level.

Technologies your team works with include:

Google Cloud Platform, Vercel
Auth0
Wiz
GitHub Advanced Security
Terraform / Terramate
Datadog, OpenTelemetry,
Cursor, MCP, and agentic engineering workflows
TypeScript, Python and GoLang

Dein Profil

Several years of experience in security engineering or security leadership, including leading or mentoring engineers.
A technical background in cloud security, preferably Google Cloud Platform, with enough depth to reason about infrastructure, CI/CD, identity, and application security.
Startup agility: you have built a security framework from scratch, or close to it, with limited initial resources and a clear view of what matters first.
Regulatory knowledge: you are familiar with cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST CSF and ISO 27001, and ideally with critical infrastructure rules like NIS2 and KRITIS.
Strong communication skills and the ability to make security risk concrete for engineers, product managers, and senior business stakeholders.
A pragmatic, outcome-oriented way of working.
Excellent English communication skills; German is a plus.

Bonus points for:

Hands-on coding experience.
Experience with security in an AI-assisted engineering setup, including agentic workflows and their guardrails.
Experience running or coordinating security incident response.
Experience with security and IT controls in a company preparing for a public listing.
Experience in a scale-up environment with roughly 100 to 1000 employees.
Interest in climate tech and renewable energy.

Benefits

You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
Flat hierarchies and short decision paths, so your work reaches production quickly
You work remotely (Germany-wide) with a genuinely flexible remote policy, and our offices in Hamburg, Berlin and Munich are there whenever you want them
Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

If you're ready to make an impact and shape the work lives of millions of people, then you've come to the right place!Our Mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.Job DescriptionFlip is the frontline employee experience platform. Hundreds of thousands of people who do not work at a desk open Flip to reach everything their employer's digital world holds for them and Bosch, REWE and Porsche are a a few of the companies that run it. You take a Flip tenant from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. Expect regular travel to customer sites, roughly 10 to 30 percent of your time.What you bring to the tableMust-havesAround 3 to 5 (or more) years in IT or tech consulting, customer engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or SaaS implementation, with real enterprise exposure.Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and identity: SSO and authentication (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID or comparable), REST APIs and API-based integrations delivered inside real enterprise IT environments.Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them.Genuine technical depth without being a full-time production developer: you read code, review a design, debug an integration and build a working prototype.German at C1 level or above and fluent English.Nice-to-havesProvisioning experience (SCIM) and integrations into HR or workforce systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.An informed, current view on where agentic AI is heading: MCP, A2A, EMA and the authentication questions underneath them. We are looking for someone who follows the field closely and has an opinion, not for years of experience that cannot exist yet.Prior work as a Customer Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer at a product company, rather than in classic consulting only.Workflow automation tooling (n8n or similar), comfort with logs, metrics and dashboards, or experience with German co-determination and enterprise data protection.What we offer youWork mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview.Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing.Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere.Be part of something bigger: You actively shape Flip in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed.Happy to be a Flipster: Stay tuned for regular team events and culture days that bring us together as Flipsters.Working abroad: At Flip you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview.At Flip, everyone is welcome - no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity, origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip. The most important thing is that YOU fit in!Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior RF Engineer II
description_clean:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior RF Hardware Engineer to our team. If you are great at what you do, enjoy working in a startup environment, and are passionate about developing leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. 


At the Senior II level, you will be tasked with full-stack hardware development for complex modules and small systems. You will have the opportunity to start at concept development and progress through detailed design, analysis, layout, build, test, and delivery, doing hands-on work at each phase. The Senior II level also introduces technical leadership opportunities, gaining responsibility for small teams of hardware engineers developing new products and systems. 


 At a small company and a startup, your work will make direct contributions to the success of the business. The work is challenging and impactful, requiring both breadth and depth of technical knowledge. Our products are made for high-reliability space and airborne applications, so designs require high levels of technical rigor while maintaining the agility of a startup environment.  


 The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. 

SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and develop RF, mixed-signal, and digital hardware for electronically steered antenna (AESA) communication systems.
Support the adaptation of existing hardware designs for new customer platforms, operational environments, and regional requirements.
Develop RF front-end, power distribution, control, and interface circuitry for phased-array communication terminals.
Own the development of hardware modules and subsystems from requirements through schematic capture, layout, integration, verification, and production release.
Develop hardware requirements, perform trade studies, and support subsystem architecture development.
Perform detailed schematic design for complex RF, mixed-signal, and high-speed digital circuit boards.
Support PCB layout activities in Altium Designer, including stack-up definition, component placement, routing reviews, and design-for-manufacturing considerations.
Perform engineering analyses including worst-case circuit analysis, signal integrity, power integrity, thermal, and reliability assessments.
Develop and execute hardware bring-up, integration, debugging, and design verification activities.
Support RF characterization, system integration, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigations using laboratory test equipment.
Define and execute environmental, qualification, and compliance testing activities, including EMI/EMC verification.
Collaborate closely with all the relevant engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.
Support technical design reviews, engineering documentation, requirements traceability, and customer-facing technical activities.
Contribute to product qualification, certification, manufacturing transfer, and production support activities.
Provide technical support for field trials, demonstrations, customer evaluations, and deployment activities.
Mentor junior engineers and technicians while promoting engineering best practices and technical rigor.
Apply knowledge of adjacent disciplines, including software, systems, RF, and mechanical engineering, to support efficient product development and integration.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor of Science (BS) degree or higher in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in board-level electronics design, analysis, and test.
Direct experience designing high-reliability electronics for space or defense applications, including part derating, worst-case analysis, and thermal constraints.
Experience owning the design phase of complex board-level electronics, including trade studies, key part selection, and detailed design.
Experience delivering hardware designs through production and deployment.
Expertise in PCB layout, including high-density interconnect (HDI) stackup design and high-speed routing.
Experience running board-level signal integrity and/or power integrity simulation tools such as Ansys SIwave, ADS SIPro, or Mentor Hyperlynx.
Strong working knowledge of adjacent fields, such as software and mechanical, that guides hardware design and system design
Expert-level proficiency in electronics design tools such as Altium.
Extensive lab experience for bring-up and verification of new hardware.
Excellent written and spoken communication skills.

WHAT WE OFFER
Experience leading small teams of hardware engineers to develop multi-module assemblies, including hardware architecture, requirements, make/buy decisions, and interconnects.
Design for space radiation environments

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python & TypeScript, Microservices & Data Pipelines)
description_clean:
EquiMatch is an AI-powered M&A origination platform connecting private equity firms, search funds, corporate development teams, and M&A advisors with acquisition targets. Behind the product is a data-heavy platform: web crawlers, LLM-driven company analyzers, scoring pipelines, a unified mailbox service, and CRM integrations — orchestrated across dozens of Python and Node.js microservices.
We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is strong in Python, solid in TypeScript, and used to owning distributed systems in production. You’ll split your time between Python services and pipelines and TypeScript services built on Encore, and you’ll be expected to set technical direction, not just execute on it. We value engineers who use AI daily to move faster and build better.
Tasks

Design, build, and operate Python and Node.js (TypeScript/Encore) microservices: define service boundaries, APIs, data flows, and integrations.
Build and maintain data pipelines — crawling, enrichment, company analysis, scoring — orchestrated with Prefect.
Model data and optimize queries on PostgreSQL (schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance).
Work with asynchronous messaging (NSQ) and background job queues to build resilient, idempotent processing.
Integrate LLM APIs into production workflows (extraction, classification, summarization) and make them reliable, observable, and cost-efficient.
Own features end-to-end: requirements, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment on Railway, and monitoring.
Improve observability and performance across services and LLM calls: tracing, metrics, slow-query analysis, failure-rate monitoring.
Drive architecture decisions, write technical designs, and mentor other engineers through reviews and pairing.
Contribute to automation (n8n) and internal tooling where needed.

Requirements

6+ years of professional backend experience, with at least 4 years of Python in production.
2+ years of professional TypeScript/Node.js experience building backend services (Encore, NestJS, Fastify, Express, or similar).
Deep experience with modern Python tooling: async/await, type hints, FastAPI or similar, Pydantic, pytest.
Strong command of microservice architecture: service decomposition, API design, resiliency, idempotency, observability.
Production experience with PostgreSQL — schema design, migrations, query optimization.
Experience with message queues or workflow orchestration (Prefect, Celery, NSQ, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar).
Track record of owning systems end-to-end in production, including incidents and performance work.
Habitual use of AI tools in day-to-day development; ability to apply AI effectively (prompting strategies, code/test generation, agentic workflows).
Clear communication, ownership mindset, and a bias toward shipping.

Nice to have

Encore experience specifically.
Web scraping and crawling at scale: rate limiting, proxies, anti-bot handling, content extraction.
Building products on LLM APIs: structured outputs, evaluation, prompt versioning, cost/latency tuning, MCP servers.
LLM observability and evaluation tooling (LangWatch, Arize Phoenix, or similar).
Observability stacks (Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry).
Analytics tooling (PostHog, ClickHouse).
Familiarity with the qori framework.
Docker and cloud deployment (Railway, AWS, GCP); Infrastructure as Code basics.
Security best practices (OWASP, OAuth2/JWT, secrets management, GDPR-aware data handling).
Experience with email/CRM integrations (IMAP, Gmail API, Microsoft Graph, HubSpot/Zoho).
Familiarity with the M&A, private equity, or B2B data space.

Our stack

Backend: Python microservices, Encore (TypeScript/Node.js) services
Orchestration & messaging: Prefect, NSQ, background job queues, n8n
Data: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse (analytics)
Infrastructure: Railway, Docker, GitHub Actions
Observability: Grafana, Tempo, LangWatch, Arize Phoenix (LLM tracing & evaluation)
Analytics & tooling: PostHog, Linear, internal skills/MCP system
AI: LLM-assisted development workflows, LLM APIs in production, MCP integrations, qori

title: Technical Product Owner (m/w/d)
description_clean:
Das sind wir
An mehreren Standorten in Europa arbeiten unsere Teams täglich daran, Versandprozesse nachhaltig zu vereinfachen. Wir setzen auf offene Zusammenarbeit sowie kurze Entscheidungswege und suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Ideen einbringen und aktiv mitgestalten möchten.
Deine Rolle
Als (Technical) Product Owner (m/w/d) bist du Teil unseres Product Teams und übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale technische Schnittstellen und Integrationen unserer Plattformen. Dein Fokus liegt insbesondere auf unseren Customer APIs, der Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) sowie perspektivisch der Unified Financial Platform (UFP) und unserer HubSpot-Integration.
Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Product, Engineering und Business. Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge, übersetzt unterschiedliche Anforderungen in klare Prioritäten und sorgst gemeinsam mit unseren Teams dafür, dass unsere Integrationen zuverlässig funktionieren und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.
Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Product Ownern, unserem Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers und Data Insights zusammen und bist gleichzeitig wichtige Ansprechperson für interne Stakeholder, Kunden, Carrier und externe Partner.
Deine Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Roadmap unserer Customer APIs für LMS Enterprise und LMS Next und entwickelst diese strategisch weiter.
Du treibst die Migration unserer API-Kunden von LMS Enterprise zu LMS Next voran und identifizierst, welche Features und Carrier-Integrationen dafür benötigt werden.
Du bist technische Ansprechperson für unsere API-Kunden und unterstützt bei Fragen sowie bei der Analyse und Lösung von Problemen.
Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit internen und externen Stakeholdern die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unified Carrier Interface (UCI).
Du analysierst Anforderungen an Carrier-Features und Services, bereitest diese für unser Engineering auf und unterstützt QA bei der Definition relevanter Test Cases.
Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Carriern und klärst technische Anforderungen und Besonderheiten rund um deren Integrationen.
Nach dem Go-live übernimmst du die Verantwortung für unsere Unified Financial Platform (UFP) und steuerst deren Backlog und Weiterentwicklung.
Du behältst unsere bestehende HubSpot-Integration im Blick und priorisierst Anpassungen entsprechend neuer Business-Anforderungen und Feedbacks.
Über alle Themen hinweg bringst du Engineering, Business Stakeholder, Carrier und externe Partner zusammen und sorgst für klare Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen.

Das bringst du mit

Du verfügst über einen technischen Hintergrund, beispielsweise in Software Engineering oder Informatik, oder hast bereits mehrere Jahre an der Schnittstelle zwischen Product und Engineering gearbeitet.
Du bringst Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager mit – idealerweise im Umfeld von APIs, Plattformen oder technischen Integrationen.
Du hast ein gutes Verständnis von APIs, API Design, Versionierung und Migrationsstrategien und kannst technische Diskussionen mit unseren Engineers auf Augenhöhe führen.
Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verstehen und sie für unterschiedliche Stakeholder verständlich übersetzen.
Du bist sicher im Stakeholder Management und kannst unterschiedliche technische und wirtschaftliche Anforderungen gegeneinander abwägen und priorisieren.
Mehrere parallele Workstreams und wechselnde Prioritäten bringen dich nicht aus dem Konzept – du behältst den Überblick und setzt klare Schwerpunkte.
Du arbeitest gerne kollaborativ und standortübergreifend mit Kollegen in Hamburg und Naarden zusammen.
Du interessierst dich für AI Tools und digitale Lösungen und probierst gerne neue Wege aus, um Prozesse und Workflows effizienter zu gestalten.
Erfahrung in Logistik, Parcel oder Freight Tech, insbesondere mit Carrier-API-Integrationen, ist ein Plus.
Kenntnisse rund um HubSpot bzw. CRM-Integrationen oder Finanz- und Invoicing Systeme sind ebenfalls von Vorteil.

Warum ITA Logistics Group?

title: Head of Brand & Marketing (m/w/d)
description_clean:
Wir wollen die lautesten Handpulled Noodles Europas werden. Dafür fehlt uns die Person, die das kreativ führt.
Bang Bang Noodles macht Handpulled Noodles. Jede Nudel von Hand gezogen, mitten im Restaurant, so dass du es siehst, hörst und spürst. Heute zwei Stores in Berlin, Kreuzberg und Mitte. Morgen deutlich mehr: Wir bauen gerade das Franchise System auf und wollen im nächsten Jahr fünf weitere Standorte eröffnen, auch außerhalb Berlins. Dazu ein starkes Team und ein Markengesicht, das schon heute Reichweite hat.
Not authentic. Just really good. Wir erzählen keine Traditionsgeschichten. Wir zeigen, was wir können, und wir sind dabei laut. Mit Absicht.
Was uns fehlt, ist die Person, die diese Haltung jeden Tag in Content, Kampagnen und Markenauftritt übersetzt. Nicht als Verwalter, sondern als Motor.
Aufgaben

Du führst die Marke. Tonalität, Look, Guidelines, und du hast das letzte Wort bei allem, was BBN nach außen zeigt: Content, Karte, Stores, Merch, Kooperationen.
Du baust unser Content System. Formate für TikTok, Reels und Stories, ein Redaktionsplan, feste Drehroutinen mit unserer Gründerin als Gesicht und der Küche als Bühne.
Du produzierst selbst. Handy raus, drei Clips in der Küche, schneiden, posten. Du bist dabei nicht allein: Im Team gibt es Leute, die filmen und schneiden können und dich an festen Tagen unterstützen, und für größere Drehs holst du Freelancer und führst sie.
Du entwickelst Brand Momente, die Berlin mitbekommt, von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, und steuerst Agenturen und Freelancer, wenn es welche braucht.
Du lieferst Creatives für Paid Social und holst dir die Learnings zurück in die Planung. Paid selbst liegt aktuell beim Founder und kann perspektivisch zu dir wandern.
Du bringst die Marke in jeden Kiez. Lokales Marketing für die bestehenden Stores und vor allem für Neueröffnungen: Launch Kampagnen, Nachbarschaft, Creator, Events. Beim Opening bist du vor Ort, auch wenn es in einer anderen Stadt ist.
Du machst die Marke auch nach innen sichtbar: Employer Brand für unser Recruiting und Material und Playbooks für unsere Franchise Partner, damit jeder Standort so laut ist wie der erste.
Du hast ein eigenes Produktionsbudget und entscheidest, wofür es draufgeht.

Qualifikation

Mindestens fünf Jahre in Brand, Content oder Kreation, angestellt oder in der Agentur. Und du hast an mindestens einer Marke mitgearbeitet, die man erkennt, weil sie Charakter hat. Consumer, Food, Lifestyle, egal welche Branche.
Du kannst es selbst. Kurze Videos mit dem Handy drehen und schneiden, Texte schreiben, Plattformen bedienen. Kein Profi Cutter nötig, aber auch kein reiner Stratege.
Du verstehst TikTok und Instagram aus der Praxis, nicht aus Reports.
Geschmack und Haltung. Du sagst nein, wenn etwas nicht zur Marke passt, auch zu uns.
Deutsch und Englisch sicher. Du bist in Berlin und willst in den Stores sein, nicht nur im Büro.
Reisebereitschaft. Bei Openings in anderen Städten bist du für ein paar Tage dabei, das gehört zum Job.

Benefits

60.000 bis 75.000 € brutto, je nach Erfahrung.
Direkte Freigabe ohne Schleifen. Du sprichst mit den Gründern, nicht mit einem Komitee.
Eigenes Office in Berlin für Konzept und Schnitt, die Stores als Set direkt vor der Tür.
Eigenes Produktionsbudget und Freelancer, die du selbst auswählst.
Eine Marke mit fertigem Fundament und ohne fertige Antworten. Vision, Werte und Tonalität stehen, alles andere baust du.
Eine Firma, die gerade den Sprung ins Franchise macht. Was du jetzt aufbaust, wird die Vorlage für jeden weiteren Standort. Und die Rolle wächst mit: Wer heute die Marke für zwei Stores führt, führt in zwei Jahren ein Team.
Weiterbildung ist uns wichtig. Eigenes Budget für Kurse, Konferenzen und Coaching, du entscheidest, was dich weiterbringt.
Noodles. So viele du willst.

So läuft es ab: Du bewirbst dich mit Portfolio oder Arbeitsproben und beantwortest eine Frage: Was würdest du bei uns als Erstes lauter machen? Kein Anschreiben. Dann ein erstes Gespräch mit den Gründern, 30 Minuten, Haltung und Fit. Danach ein bezahlter Case: dein 90 Tage Plan für BBN, präsentiert im Store. Zum Schluss ein zweites Gespräch zu Rahmen und Vertrag. Vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Entscheidung: maximal vier Wochen.
Made loud.

description_clean:

Deine Rolle
Du baust unser Marketing gemeinsam mit den Gründern auf der grünen Wiese auf. Funnel und Daten: Du verbindest Marketing und Vertrieb, arbeitest eng mit unserem CRM (HubSpot) und machst sichtbar, welche Maßnahmen tatsächlich Investoren bringen.
AI-First: Du baust unser Marketing AI-first auf und hebst mit AI-Tools Effizienzen in allen Bereichen: bei der Content-Erstellung, im Schnitt, bei Creatives, in der Auswertung von Kampagnen und in der Automatisierung von Prozessen. Was manuell nicht sein muss, wird es bei dir auch nicht. Das Budget für die passenden Tools stellen wir, welche das sind, entscheidest du.
Perspektive: Mit wachsendem Erfolg baust du dein eigenes Team auf und führst Praktikanten, Werkstudenten und Freelancer.

Qualifikation

Du hast 2 bis 3 Jahre Arbeitserfahrung im Growth- oder Marketing-Bereich eines Startups oder Scale-ups und einen Proven Track Record: Kanäle, Kampagnen oder Prozesse, die du messbar aufgebaut oder skaliert hast
Du bist hands-on in mindestens zwei der drei Bereiche Content, Newsletter und Performance-Marketing und hast Lust, den dritten zu meistern
Du arbeitest dich sehr schnell tief in erneuerbare Energien, Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und die steuerliche Logik unserer Investments ein. Nur wer das Produkt versteht, kann dafür Marketing machen, das Investoren überzeugt
Du arbeitest datengetrieben: Tracking, Attribution, A/B-Tests und Reporting sind für dich Werkzeuge, keine BuzzwordsDu hast ein gutes Auge für Ästhetik und Storytelling und Erfahrung im Videoschnitt, idealerweise auch mit Kamera, Ton und Licht
Du stehst selbst gerne vor der Kamera oder bist bereit, es zu lernenDu verstehst, wie YouTube, LinkedIn und Instagram funktionieren, im Short- wie im Longform-BereichDu arbeitest AI-first: AI-Tools sind für dich in Content-Produktion, Auswertung und Automatisierung fester Teil des Workflows, und du suchst aktiv nach weiteren Hebeln, um schneller und besser zu werden
Du arbeitest mit hoher Autonomie, triffst Entscheidungen selbst und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse, auch wenn es unbequem wirdSehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ein sicheres Gespür für Sprache und Tonalität
Du bist verfügbar für eine Vollzeitstelle und bereit, an 5 Tagen pro Woche in unserem Berliner Büro zu arbeitenBonus: Du bringst bereits Vorkenntnisse in erneuerbaren Energien oder Energiemärkten mit oder hast Erfahrung im Marketing für Finanz- oder Investmentprodukte

Benefits

Ownership und Impact: Du baust das Marketing von Sunpeak Capital von Anfang an mit auf, arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und hast prägenden Einfluss darauf, wie wir am Markt wahrgenommen werden
Kompetitive Vergütung: Top Leistung wird bei uns auch adäquat bezahlt**.**
Kostenfreie Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft: Power dich nach der Arbeit aus beim Sport.
Modernes Office in Berlin Mitte: Kaffee in Barista-Qualität, ergonomische Designer-Möbel und technisches Top-Setup (Apple Hardware + XXL Screens).
Regelmäßige Team-Events: Gemeinsame Aktivitäten wie Surfen oder eine Bootsfahrt stärken das Miteinander und machen die Zeit bei uns noch besser.
Bezahlte Lunches: Wir sorgen für dein leibliches Wohl.
Workation: Anfang 2027 reist wir gemeinsam für 2 Wochen nach Kapstadt.

Über uns
Sunpeak Capital entstand aus der gemeinsamen Vision von Konstantin und Jan. Vor der Gründung waren sie die ersten beiden Mitarbeiter des Fintech-Scale-ups Cloover, welches PV-Anlagen finanziert. Für dieses bauten sie den deutschen Markt auf und skalierten und das Partnernetzwerk auf über 200 Installationsbetriebe. In dieser Zeit erkannten sie, welches Potenzial entsteht, wenn man Kapital gezielt in nachhaltige Energieprojekte lenkt.
Anfang 2025 gründeten sie dann Sunpeak Capital - vollständig gebootstrapped und bereits nach zwei Monaten profitabel. Ihr Antrieb: die Mechanismen des Kapitalmarkts nutzen, um den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien zu beschleunigen und Investoren echte Rendite mit echtem Impact zu ermöglichen.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!
